title: People’s Mañanera October 21
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Pemex Grows Stronger Through Sovereignty and Environmental Responsibility  
** Under the Fourth Transformation (4T), Pemex has reduced its debt by more
than US$20.00 billion and will invest 1.8 trillion pesos (US$96.70 billion) by
2030, prioritizing supply and capping production at 1.8 million barrels per
day, while ensuring environmental protection.

**Blow to Fuel Theft: 48.00 Billion Pesos Recovered  
** The Mexican government reported an additional 48.00 billion pesos (US$2.58
billion) in revenue, more than 2,500 arrests, and 173.7 million liters seized
in moves against fuel theft, known as huachicol. Technology and coordination
are being used to combat smuggling, tax evasion, and corruption.

**Federal Government Support to Resolve the Water Crisis in Jalisco  
** The Mexican government will provide all the necessary funds, estimated at
between 12.00 billion and 13.00 billion pesos (US$640 million and US$700
million), to address the crisis and ensure a supply of drinking water for the
people of Guadalajara.

**Mexico Strengthens the Search for Missing Persons  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum highlighted the progress recognized by the UN
regarding missing, abducted and forcibly disappeared persons, resulting from
the strengthening of search mechanisms and coordination with victims'
families.

**Lie Detector  
** * It is not true that President Claudia Sheinbaum mocked the protests by
Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS) workers  
* It is not true that the President accused IMSS workers of stealing medications and causing the pharmaceutical shortage  
* It is not true that the National Pediatric Institute (INP) forced staff to prepare spoiled food  
* It is not true that the comprehensive anesthesia service is no longer covering IMSS medical units  
* It is not true that flies were found inside the National Neurology Institute  
* Published salary tables for IMSS workers are fake
